005package org.wpilib.driverstation;
006
007import java.util.Optional;
008import java.util.OptionalInt;
009import org.wpilib.driverstation.internal.DriverStationBackend;
010
011/** Provides access to match state information from the Driver Station. */
012public final class MatchState {
013  private MatchState() {}
014
015  /**
016   * Return the approximate match time. The FMS does not send an official match time to the robots,
017   * but does send an approximate match time. The value will count down the time remaining in the
018   * current period (auto or teleop). Warning: This is not an official time (so it cannot be used to
019   * dispute ref calls or guarantee that a function will trigger before the match ends).
020   *
021   * <p>This number only changes in full integer increments and always counts down, both when
022   * connected to the real field and when the DS is in match mode.
023   *
024   * <p>When the DS is in teleop or autonomous mode, this number returns -1.0.
025   *
026   * <p>Simulation matches DS behavior without an FMS connected.
027   *
028   * @return Time remaining in current match period (auto or teleop) in seconds
029   */
030  public static double getMatchTime() {
031    return DriverStationBackend.getMatchTime();
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Get the current alliance from the FMS.
036   *
037   * <p>If the FMS is not connected, it is set from the team alliance setting on the driver station.
038   *
039   * @return The alliance (red or blue) or an empty optional if the alliance is invalid
040   */
041  public static Optional<Alliance> getAlliance() {
042    return DriverStationBackend.getAlliance();
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Gets the location of the team's driver station controls from the FMS.
047   *
048   * <p>If the FMS is not connected, it is set from the team alliance setting on the driver station.
049   *
050   * @return the location of the team's driver station controls: 1, 2, or 3
051   */
052  public static OptionalInt getLocation() {
053    return DriverStationBackend.getLocation();
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Get the replay number from the FMS.
058   *
059   * @return the replay number
060   */
061  public static int getReplayNumber() {
062    return DriverStationBackend.getReplayNumber();
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Get the match number from the FMS.
067   *
068   * @return the match number
069   */
070  public static int getMatchNumber() {
071    return DriverStationBackend.getMatchNumber();
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Get the match type from the FMS.
076   *
077   * @return the match type
078   */
079  public static MatchType getMatchType() {
080    return DriverStationBackend.getMatchType();
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Get the event name from the FMS.
085   *
086   * @return the event name
087   */
088  public static String getEventName() {
089    return DriverStationBackend.getEventName();
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * Get the game specific message from the FMS.
094   *
095   * <p>If the FMS is not connected, it is set from the game data setting on the driver station.
096   *
097   * @return the game specific message
098   */
099  public static Optional<String> getGameData() {
100    return DriverStationBackend.getGameData();
101  }
102}
